methods.label: Refute with a counterexample
methods.explanation: Vertically opposite angles are always equal, but equal angles are not necessarily vertically opposite angles. For example, two right angles are equal but need not be vertically opposite angles, so the proposition is false.
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 proposition testing by an elementary geometric counterexample.
